training_guidance: This index page establishes the document hierarchy for Bonfiglioli technical standards MTQ-000 through MTQ-002

TAB sheets (TAB 001-TAB 099) define specific geometric features: threading (TAB 002, TAB 008, TAB 017), bearing seats (TAB 005, TAB 010), seals (TAB 004, TAB 009), splines (TAB 007, TAB 012), keyways (TAB 014), gears (TAB 011), and assembly conventions (TAB 098, TAB 099)

Component families (66xxx series) organize part types: shafts (66300-A, 66301-B, 66301, 66311), gears (66420, 66430, 66450, 66455), planetary systems (66340-A, 66345-A, 66410-A), and fasteners (66600)
When modeling NX parts, reference the appropriate TAB sheet for feature-specific standards (e.g., TAB 005 for bearing seats, TAB 012 for spline representation)
Component family codes should guide part template selection and feature requirements in automated modeling workflows
summary: Page 6 presents the master index for Bonfiglioli's Technical Quality Handbook MTQ-001. It organizes technical standards into TAB sheets covering specific geometric features (threads, bearing seats, seals, splines, keyways, gears) and component families (66xxx series) covering shafts, gears, planetary systems, and fasteners. This index serves as the navigation structure for detailed engineering rules found in subsequent pages.
